verdict.rationale: Canny is a SaaS feedback platform with an API, SDK and MCP server, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a sandbox, test mode, staging workspace, or any other way to isolate test activity from production data. The MCP material describes acting on real customer data, which is the opposite of isolation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
